name: powerdns__listServers
description:
List all servers


**Responses:**

- **200** (Success): An array of servers
  - Content-Type: `application/json`

  - **Response Item Properties:**

    - **type**: Set to “Server”

    - **id**: The id of the server, “localhost”

    - **daemon_type**: “recursor” for the PowerDNS Recursor and “authoritative” for the Authoritative Server

    - **version**: The version of the server software

    - **url**: The API endpoint for this server

    - **config_url**: The API endpoint for this server’s configuration

    - **zones_url**: The API endpoint for this server’s zones

  - **Example:**
```json
[
  {
    "type": "string",
    "id": "string",
    "daemon_type": "string"
  }
]
```

name: powerdns__listZones
description:
List all Zones in a server


**Path Parameters:**

- **server_id** (Required): The id of the server to retrieve


**Query Parameters:**

- **zone**: When set to the name of a zone, only this zone is returned.
If no zone with that name exists, the response is an empty array.
This can e.g. be used to check if a zone exists in the database without having to guess/encode the zone's id or to check if a zone exists.


- **dnssec**: “true” (default) or “false”, whether to include the “dnssec” and “edited_serial” fields in the Zone objects. Setting this to ”false” will make the query a lot faster.


**Responses:**

- **200** (Success): An array of Zones
  - Content-Type: `application/json`

  - **Response Item Properties:**

    - **id**: Opaque zone id (string), assigned by the server, should not be interpreted by the application. Guaranteed to be safe for embedding in URLs.

    - **name**: Name of the zone (e.g. “example.com.”) MUST have a trailing dot

    - **type**: Set to “Zone”

    - **url**: API endpoint for this zone

    - **kind**: Zone kind, one of “Native”, “Master”, “Slave”, “Producer”, “Consumer”

    - **rrsets**: RRSets in this zone (for zones/{zone_id} endpoint only; omitted during GET on the .../zones list endpoint)

    - **serial**: The SOA serial number

    - **notified_serial**: The SOA serial notifications have been sent out for

    - **edited_serial**: The SOA serial as seen in query responses. Calculated using the SOA-EDIT metadata, default-soa-edit and default-soa-edit-signed settings

    - **masters**: List of IP addresses configured as a master for this zone (“Slave” type zones only)

    - **dnssec**: Whether or not this zone is DNSSEC signed (inferred from presigned being true XOR presence of at least one cryptokey with active being true)

    - **nsec3param**: The NSEC3PARAM record

    - **nsec3narrow**: Whether or not the zone uses NSEC3 narrow

    - **presigned**: Whether or not the zone is pre-signed

    - **soa_edit**: The SOA-EDIT metadata item

    - **soa_edit_api**: The SOA-EDIT-API metadata item

    - **api_rectify**: Whether or not the zone will be rectified on data changes via the API

    - **zone**: MAY contain a BIND-style zone file when creating a zone

    - **catalog**: The catalog this zone is a member of

    - **account**: MAY be set. Its value is defined by local policy

    - **nameservers**: MAY be sent in client bodies during creation, and MUST NOT be sent by the server. Simple list of strings of nameserver names, including the trailing dot. Not required for slave zones.

    - **master_tsig_key_ids**: The id of the TSIG keys used for master operation in this zone

    - **slave_tsig_key_ids**: The id of the TSIG keys used for slave operation in this zone

  - **Example:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "type": "string"
  }
]
```

name: powerdns__patchZone

**Path Parameters:**

- **zone_id** (Required): The id of the zone to retrieve

- **name**: Name of the zone (e.g. “example.com.”) MUST have a trailing dot

- **masters**: List of IP addresses configured as a master for this zone (“Slave” type zones only)

- **dnssec**: Whether or not this zone is DNSSEC signed (inferred from presigned being true XOR presence of at least one cryptokey with active being true)

- **nsec3param**: The NSEC3PARAM record

- **nsec3narrow**: Whether or not the zone uses NSEC3 narrow

- **presigned**: Whether or not the zone is pre-signed

- **soa_edit**: The SOA-EDIT metadata item

- **soa_edit_api**: The SOA-EDIT-API metadata item

- **api_rectify**: Whether or not the zone will be rectified on data changes via the API

- **zone**: MAY contain a BIND-style zone file when creating a zone

- **account**: MAY be set. Its value is defined by local policy

- **nameservers**: MAY be sent in client bodies during creation, and MUST NOT be sent by the server. Simple list of strings of nameserver names, including the trailing dot. Not required for slave zones.

- **master_tsig_key_ids**: The id of the TSIG keys used for master operation in this zone

**Responses:**

name.description: Name of the zone (e.g. “example.com.”) MUST have a trailing dot

ttl.description: DNS TTL of the records, in seconds. MUST NOT be included when changetype is set to “DELETE”.

changetype.description: MUST be added when updating the RRSet. Must be one of DELETE, EXTEND, PRUNE or REPLACE. With DELETE, all existing RRs matching name and type will be deleted, including all comments. With EXTEND, only a single record shall be present, and it will be added to the RRSet if not already present. With PRUNE, only a single record shall be present, and it will be deleted from the RRSet if present. With REPLACE, when records is present, all existing RRs matching name and type will be deleted, and then new records given in records will be created. If no records are left, any existing comments will be deleted as well. When comments is present, all existing comments for the RRs matching name and type will be deleted, and then new comments given in comments will be created.

disabled.description: Whether or not this record is disabled. When unset, the record is not disabled

items.description: The RREntry object represents a single record.

modified_at.description: Timestamp of the last change to the record

records.description: All records in this RRSet. When updating Records, this is the list of new records (replacing the old ones). Must be empty when changetype is set to DELETE, and must contain only one element when changetype is set to EXTEND or PRUNE. An empty list results in deletion of all records (and comments).

account.description: Name of an account that added the comment

modified_at.description: Timestamp of the last change to the comment

comments.description: List of Comment. Must be empty when changetype is set to DELETE, EXTEND or PRUNE. An empty list results in deletion of all comments. modified_at is optional and defaults to the current server time.

write_unchanged.description: In the case of a PRUNE or EXTEND operation, specifies whether a database update should be performed even if the operation does not change the RRSet, causing the modification timestamp to be updated if the backend supports it.

name: powerdns__searchData
description:
Search the data inside PowerDNS for search_term and return at most max_results. This includes zones, records and comments. The * character can be used in search_term as a wildcard character and the ? character can be used as a wildcard for a single character.


**Path Parameters:**

- **server_id** (Required): The id of the server to retrieve


**Query Parameters:**

- **q** (Required): The string to search for

- **max** (Required): Maximum number of entries to return

- **object_type**: Type of data to search for, one of “all”, “zone”, “record”, “comment”


**Responses:**

- **200** (Success): Returns a JSON array with results
  - Content-Type: `application/json`

  - **Example:**
```json
[
  {
    "key": "value"
  }
]
```
